name: ASML Holding
business: ASML designs and manufactures photolithography equipment used in semiconductor fabrication. Its EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet) lithography systems are required for producing the most advanced chips.
competitive_position: Sole supplier of EUV lithography systems worldwide. Deep moat from decades of accumulated engineering knowledge, IP, and customer integration.
revenue_model: Equipment sales (capital equipment) plus long-term service and upgrade contracts. Service revenue provides recurring income.
key_risks: Export control restrictions limiting sales to certain countries — impact on bookings is an open research question
Customer concentration among a small number of leading-edge chip manufacturers
Long technology development cycles create execution risk
